usedFor: Acadle holds your learners, and Microsoft Excel keeps a table where “New User” adds a row for each one.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in Acadle, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every new learner lands as a row, so the roster table grows without anyone typing it in.

watchOut: Acadle triggers are polling, so a row appears after the next scheduled check, not the moment a user signs up.
